{"result":"[order-service#Integrations]
OrderService: Integrations
It calls the PaymentsAPI to authorize and capture. It depends on UserService to resolve the ordering customer.

[payments-service#Overview]
PaymentsService: Overview
PaymentsService exposes the PaymentsAPI. It wraps the external payment provider so that no other service holds provider credentials.

[payments-service#Integrations]
PaymentsService: Integrations
It calls the NotificationsAPI on a declined authorization, so the customer hears about a decline even when checkout has already returned.

PaymentsService is maintained by the same team as BillingService.

[renewals-worker#Integrations]
RenewalsWorker: Integrations
It depends on BillingService and calls the PaymentsAPI directly, without going through OrderService, because a renewal has no cart.

[payments-service#Data]
PaymentsService: Data
It stores authorizations in the payments Postgres database, with the provider's reference for each one.

[billing-service#Integrations]
BillingService: Integrations
It depends on OrderService for line items. It calls the NotificationsAPI to send receipts once a capture succeeds.

The billing-service team also maintains the shared invoice templates.

[payments-service#Operations]
PaymentsService: Operations
Calls to the provider are retried on network errors only, never on a decline, because retrying a decline can trigger the provider's fraud checks.

[payments-service#Configuration]
PaymentsService: Configuration
It is configured by PAYMENT_API_KEY and CAPTURE_TIMEOUT. CAPTURE_TIMEOUT is in seconds and defaults to 30."}

content.text:
The docs name two services that call the **PaymentsAPI** directly:

1. **OrderService** calls the PaymentsAPI to authorize and capture payments during checkout (order-service#Integrations). If an authorization times out, it retries once after two seconds. If it times out again, it cancels the checkout and releases the reserved stock (order-service#Operations).
2. **RenewalsWorker** calls the PaymentsAPI directly rather than going through OrderService, because a renewal has no cart. It also depends on **BillingService** (renewals-worker#Integrations).

Related parts of the system:
- **PaymentsService** provides the PaymentsAPI. It wraps the external payment provider so that no other service holds provider credentials. It stores authorizations in the **payments Postgres database**.
- PaymentsService is configured by **PAYMENT_API_KEY** and **CAPTURE_TIMEOUT**, which is in seconds and defaults to 30.

Services that don't call it directly:
- **ApiGateway** calls only the **OrdersAPI** and **UsersAPI**, so it reaches payments only through OrderService.
- **BillingService** calls the **NotificationsAPI**, not the PaymentsAPI.

The docs mention no other callers of the PaymentsAPI.
